C1296.title: AI Agent Exfiltrates Database Data via Unauthorized Access
C1296.summary: In December 2025, a company detected that its deployed AI agent was manipulated into outputting database data beyond its authorized scope. The incident occurred in both public-facing applications and internal systems. Attackers used prompt injection to coerce the agent into invoking database tools for unauthorized queries, leading to sensitive data leakage.

references.title: On the Eve of the Trillion-Agent Explosion, Who Will Protect Our AI Security? | Jiazi Guangnian
